info.title: Saihub REST API
info.description: No-TLS JSON REST API for logical pins 0-7, PWM, UART, power rails (3v3/5v), edge tracing, resource locks, and on-device Lua 5.4 scripts. All time fields are microseconds. JSON keys are camelCase. Error bodies are {"reason":"..."}.

tags.name: script
tags.description: Sandboxed Lua 5.4. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8. require/dofile/loadfile/load/collectgarbage are nil. No io, os, package, debug, or coroutine. Tools are globals with MCP argument keys. sleep(us) delays in microseconds. print() is captured. First return value is result. Errors raise {reason="..."}; catch with pcall. Timeout, maxCalls, and out-of-memory abort the run.

get.description: Browser page for humans to control pins, power rails, and UART. Agents should use GET /openapi.json and call the JSON APIs instead of scraping this page.

post.description: Stateless MCP Streamable HTTP transport. POST a single JSON-RPC request or notification. Responses are application/json (no SSE). Notifications and client responses return 202. Pin tools are plural and take pins arrays; create_lock resources use type pin+pins, type power+rails, or type uart+ids. See tools/list.

id.description: Present for requests; omit for notifications

202.description: Accepted notification or client response (empty body)

post.description:
Execute a sandboxed Lua 5.4 script that can call the same pin/power/lock tools as MCP (not run_script). Optional maxCalls and timeout (microseconds) must not exceed firmware ceilings. Default lock for nested tool calls: X-Lock-Id. One script at a time.

Lua 5.4. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8. require, dofile, loadfile, load, and collectgarbage are nil. No io, os, package, debug, or coroutine.

Each tool is a global that takes one argument table with the same keys as MCP (always pass pins even for one pin). JSON arrays become 1-based Lua tables. sleep(us) delays in microseconds and counts toward timeout, not maxCalls. print() is captured as output. The first return value is result (JSON).

Errors raise a table {reason="..."}. Catch with pcall and read err.reason. Uncaught errors fail the request with that reason; print output is discarded.

Catchable with pcall:
- Tool failure: system sentence (no "The script reported" prefix), e.g. pin/lock/mode errors
- error("msg"): "The script reported an error: msg. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."
- error() or error(""): "The script called error with no message. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."

Not catchable (abort the whole run even if pcall returns):
- timeout: "Script exceeded timeout."
- maxCalls: "Script exceeded maxCalls."
- out of memory: "Script ran out of memory."
- syntax or uncaught Lua runtime: "The script failed: <message>. Catch it with pcall or fix the script."

Example:
configure_pins{pins={0}, mode="digitalOutput", pullUp=false, pullDown=false}
set_pin_levels{pins={0}, level=1}
sleep(5000)
local r = get_pin_levels{pins={0}}
print("level", r.levels[1])
return r

Error handling:
local ok, err = pcall(function()
  set_pin_levels{pins={0}, level=1}
end)
if not ok then
  return {ok=false, reason=err.reason}
end

parameters.name: X-Lock-Id
parameters.description: Default lockId injected into tool calls that omit lockId

script.description: Lua 5.4 source. Allowed libraries: base, table, string, math, utf8.

maxCalls.description: Max tool invocations this run (default and ceiling from firmware)

timeout.description: Wall-clock budget in microseconds (default and ceiling from firmware)

400.description: invalid JSON, out-of-range params, or Lua source failed to parse

422.description: Uncaught error() or tool failure, timeout, maxCalls exceeded, or script heap exhausted

XLockId.name: X-Lock-Id
XLockId.description: Required when another lock holds the resource+method (pin, power rail, or UART). Missing or unknown yields 412; a different live holder or peripheral reservation yields 423.

TimeUs.description: Unix epoch or duration in microseconds

openDrain.description: Allowed for digitalOutput, digitalInputOutput, and pwmOutput

level.description: digitalOutput: last written latch. Otherwise sampled pad input.

frequency.description: Hz. Very low frequencies may be rejected.

reason.description: Human-readable fix sentence, except invalid_json and internal

result.description: First Lua 5.4 return value as JSON, or null. JSON arrays in tool results are 1-based Lua tables.

data.description: UTF-8 string when encoding is utf8; array of 0-255 integers when encoding is byte.

NotFound.description: Unknown URL, pin in path out of 0-7, UART id missing from GET /uart/, or lock id missing on PUT

Conflict.description: POST /lock overlaps an existing lock or peripheral hold; or UART enable conflicts with a held pin

Unprocessable.description: Pin mode cannot perform the operation, PWM resources exhausted, or UART not enabled / missing direction pin

Locked.description: Resource+method held by a different live lock, or reserved by a peripheral such as UART
